title: Scrum transformation with documented ChatGPT support
summary: Teams transform their earlier traditional project plan into Scrum artifacts including user stories, product and sprint backlogs, Definition of Done, MVP, roles, and sprint events. ChatGPT supports ideation and critique, but teams must document every interaction, revise generated material, and defend their own artifacts in person.

sources.title: Integrating ChatGPT in Project Management Education: Benefits and Challenges in the Academic Environment
sources.evidence_quote: In the second practical assignment, the students were tasked with transforming the planning developed in the previous assignment into agile artifacts using SCRUM.
